comparison_scope: 24 direct or adjacent benchmarks; public evidence depths differ; no claim of exhaustive market coverage.

competitors.name: Structured
competitors.selection_reason: Scale reported by vendor; close daily-planning fit
competitors.operation: Capture untimed work in Inbox, place sessions on a timeline, complete and revisit the day.
competitors.interface_pattern: Vertical time axis, compact day strip, colored task circles, persistent add control.
competitors.monetization: Free + Pro; monthly/yearly/lifetime.
competitors.performance_basis: 15M+ downloads, 500K+ Pro users: vendor claims, date/definitions unspecified.
competitors.adopt: A readable Today timeline with unscheduled capture.
competitors.change_or_omit: Add capacity explanations, linked goals, recovery and undo; do not inherit feature-parity assumptions.
competitors.decision: Proposed inspiration; not selected or implemented

competitors.name: Tiimo
competitors.operation: Break projects into tasks, plan a visual day, use a focused timer.
competitors.interface_pattern: Color/emoji task blocks, a day agenda, timer with subtasks, separate trophy view.
competitors.monetization: Paid offer/price not verified in this audit.
competitors.performance_basis: Apple iPhone App of the Year 2025; award, not sales rank.
competitors.adopt: Progressive questions and one focused action view.
competitors.change_or_omit: Keep accessibility and reduce decorative density; AI suggestions require review.
competitors.decision: Proposed inspiration; not selected or implemented

competitors.name: Todoist
competitors.operation: Quickly capture a task with date/attributes, organize projects and choose list/board/calendar views.
competitors.interface_pattern: Compact task rows and quick-add entry.
competitors.monetization: Free Beginner; Pro subscription.
competitors.performance_basis: Not ranked as a sales leader in this audit.
competitors.adopt: A global capture box with visible date/goal chips.
competitors.change_or_omit: Preview ambiguous date parsing and distinguish due date from scheduled time.
competitors.decision: Proposed inspiration; not selected or implemented

competitors.name: Motion
competitors.operation: Use task constraints to place work into available calendar time and revise the plan.
competitors.interface_pattern: Calendar and task agenda; account UI not exercised.
competitors.monetization: Subscription; exact billing/segment price unresolved.
competitors.performance_basis: No comparable audited sales or active-user metric verified.
competitors.adopt: Capacity-aware scheduling and an obvious next task.
competitors.change_or_omit: Require a proposed change list before moving locked or user-controlled commitments.
competitors.decision: Proposed inspiration; not selected or implemented

competitors.name: Sunsama
competitors.operation: Review yesterday, select tasks, check workload, arrange/timebox and begin.
competitors.interface_pattern: Guided planning ritual with workload and shutdown-time feedback.
competitors.monetization: $22/month or $204/year USD.
competitors.performance_basis: Vendor business claims are not a measured market ranking.
competitors.adopt: A short morning plan and achievable workday.
competitors.change_or_omit: Offer a fast path for busy days; incorporate family, meals and recovery in capacity.
competitors.decision: Proposed inspiration; not selected or implemented

competitors.name: Habitica
competitors.operation: Complete habits/dailies/tasks to gain XP, gold and items; quests add accountability.
competitors.interface_pattern: Separate task columns, avatar statistics, inventory and rewards.
competitors.monetization: Game economy present; current paid price not verified.
competitors.performance_basis: Specialist relevance; current revenue rank unverified.
competitors.adopt: Campaigns, attributes, personal rewards and milestones.
competitors.change_or_omit: Omit damage for missed habits and pressure on party members; keep rewards tied to sustainable behavior.
competitors.decision: Proposed inspiration; not selected or implemented

competitors.name: Finch
competitors.selection_reason: Chart presence and large store-rating sample
competitors.operation: Select small goals, earn energy through care, send pet on an adventure and return to its story.
competitors.interface_pattern: Warm companion theme and a small-action loop; native tap sequence not tested.
competitors.monetization: Free core; optional Finch Plus.
competitors.performance_basis: US free chart 11; separate listing 12, 4.9/757K ratings at retrieval.
competitors.adopt: Supportive return loop, customizable goals, celebration of small effort.
competitors.change_or_omit: Translate emotional progress into an optional Stoic journey; no compulsory pet or guilt prompts.
competitors.decision: Proposed inspiration; not selected or implemented

competitors.name: Fabulous
competitors.operation: Start with a desired life change; follow routines and use coaching resources.
competitors.interface_pattern: Motivation-first landing questionnaire and themed coaching content.
competitors.monetization: Current exact offer not verified.
competitors.performance_basis: Specialist relevance; not verified as a top seller.
competitors.adopt: Small routines and practical coaching prompts.
competitors.change_or_omit: Avoid long setup before the first useful day; every prompt should lead to a concrete action.
competitors.decision: Proposed inspiration; not selected or implemented

competitors.name: Duolingo
competitors.operation: Repeat small learning sessions; streaks/freeze mechanics encourage return.
competitors.interface_pattern: A prominent continuity/progress mechanic; current native lesson screens not inspected.
competitors.monetization: Free and paid subscriber business; local current price not verified.
competitors.performance_basis: Q4 2025: 52.7M DAU, 133.1M MAU, 12.2M paid subscribers.

competitors.change_or_omit: Practice evidence determines skill mastery; XP and streaks do not certify physical readiness.
competitors.decision: Proposed inspiration; not selected or implemented

competitors.name: MyFitnessPal
competitors.operation: Log food through several entry modes; inspect targets; paid meal plans produce shopping support.

competitors.performance_basis: US free chart 10; included in Sensor Tower US Q4 2025 revenue leaders.
competitors.adopt: Saved meals, editable fast capture, recipes and groceries.
competitors.change_or_omit: Make source/portion corrections obvious; explain paid boundaries before users invest effort.
competitors.decision: Proposed inspiration; not selected or implemented

competitors.name: Cronometer
competitors.selection_reason: Chart presence and detailed nutrient specialty
competitors.operation: Log food and inspect energy/macros/micronutrients; Gold adds richer charts and import.
competitors.interface_pattern: Summary bars/rings with deeper nutrient detail; prominent diary add action.
competitors.monetization: Free Basic; Gold displayed $10.99 USD/month.
competitors.performance_basis: US free chart 20; no audited paying-user count verified.
competitors.adopt: Nutrient source labels and detail on demand.
competitors.change_or_omit: Use a simple daily summary first; do not equate missing nutrient data with zero.
competitors.decision: Proposed inspiration; not selected or implemented

competitors.name: MacroFactor
competitors.selection_reason: Adaptive planning and bundled workout competitor
competitors.operation: Log intake and weight; estimated expenditure informs periodic target updates.
competitors.interface_pattern: Strategy/check-in screen, trend view and explanations of program changes.
competitors.monetization: Single app $71.99/year or $11.99/month; qualifying bundle $89.99/year USD.
competitors.performance_basis: Vendor product page says 500K users; activity/payment definitions unknown.
competitors.adopt: Weekly review, trend-based estimates and explanations.
competitors.change_or_omit: Require sufficient reliable data; use independently specified formulas and show uncertainty.
competitors.decision: Proposed inspiration; not selected or implemented

competitors.name: Lose It!
competitors.operation: Food tracking continues through a free-to-Premium upgrade with prior account history retained.
competitors.interface_pattern: Exact native screens uninspected; documentation establishes upgrade continuity.
competitors.monetization: Variable promotional pricing; current universal price cannot be stated.
competitors.performance_basis: Not assigned a revenue rank here.
competitors.adopt: Preserve history and favorites across paid/free transitions.
competitors.change_or_omit: Offer transparent, stable terms; avoid deriving causal effectiveness from subscriber comparisons.
competitors.decision: Proposed inspiration; not selected or implemented

competitors.name: Zero

competitors.operation: Start/edit an eating-window timer and review food/protein and timing history.

competitors.monetization: Try-free/download offer; current price not verified.
competitors.performance_basis: Vendor number-one claim not treated as ranking evidence.
competitors.adopt: Optional timing controls and editable timestamps.
competitors.change_or_omit: Exclude fasting-duration XP and unsupported physiological countdowns.
competitors.decision: Proposed inspiration; not selected or implemented

competitors.name: Cal AI

competitors.operation: Capture a photo, barcode or description and review nutrition output.
